After the three trials, claim the heart in the nave. Do not mistake silence for a permanent shutdown. After claiming the treasure, hold echo dust and click the core (cost: two dust) to awaken the Custodian. Its fractures target the ground; its crown leaves a safe centre. Strike its core after each attack.

guide.tnd.page.0.1: Explore seven biomes including Nacre-9. New city districts appear in unexplored terrain.
guide.tnd.page.0.2: Use natural survey desks. Bind a prism to an anchor before a long journey.
guide.tnd.page.1.0: Lithoguard: leave its circles during the 2 s wind-up. Strike during its recovery.
guide.tnd.page.1.1: Stalker: three marks announce its salvo. A hit of at least 3 damage interrupts the wind-up.
guide.tnd.page.1.2: Hammer: hold 1 s on the ground. Frontal 5-block wave; 6 s cooldown, 3 durability cost.
guide.tnd.page.2.0: Golden auralite: exposed expanse, field and dune floors. Iron pickaxe. Makes fast tools.
guide.tnd.page.2.1: Violet noctilite: exposed glass woods, basin and shelf floors. Smelt for crystals.
guide.tnd.page.2.2: 4 crystals + 4 tempered alloys + 1 filament = 4 Umbra alloys. Armor, tools and hammer.
guide.tnd.page.3.0: Separator: 1 raw mineral + 1 dust → 2 grit in 12 s. Smelt the grit afterwards.
guide.tnd.page.3.1: Forge: echo dust + raw metal. Input above, dust through sides, output underneath.
guide.tnd.page.3.2: Reaper: 5 × 5 bed at its height, Vestige night. 1 coal = 8 harvests; 10 s per mature aggregate.
guide.tnd.page.4.0: The tab below masteries opens eight objectives. Desks show the same personal notes.
guide.tnd.page.4.1: Claim each reward using its button. Tooltips list rewards and recorded biomes.
guide.tnd.page.4.2: Notes and rewards survive death. Seven claimed rewards unlock the cartographer trophy.

gate.tnd.guide.diagram: Top view: monitor in the centre; four coils at the corners. EIGHT frames form the 3×3 border one block BELOW.
gate.tnd.guide.text.0: Place the monitor within 8 blocks of the ancient controller (vertical gap ≤ 3). Craft with frames, circuits, copper and Nether quartz. No Vestige material required.
gate.tnd.guide.text.1: Connect a dynamo or accumulator through energy cables. The monitor stores 32,000 FE. First activation costs 16,000 FE and ONE composite crystal (blue + red + green shards). Put the crystal in the monitor, or feed it with a hopper. Start becomes available once all conditions are met. Resources are consumed only if linking succeeds. Cancel, apply a redstone signal or remove a coil to interrupt the sequence without spending crystal or FE.
gate.tnd.guide.text.2: Start charging: the gate unfolds over 6 seconds. Then interact with its controller to travel. Keep the Overworld monitor assembled to depart again; later trips are free. Return from Vestige always remains available even if the monitor is destroyed. An obstructed arrival never deletes blocks: clear room and try again. Existing links are preserved. Open Archives for the first story fragment, then seek seven memory terminals in the towers of Nacre-9.
codex.tnd.name: Nacre Archives
codex.tnd.locked_text: The reading is incomplete. Other terminals carry this symbol throughout Nacre.

codex.tnd.text.0: Link manual, fragment 01. The Architects did not discover Vestige: they connected it. Composite crystals preserve three frequencies from heat, roots and deep water. A monitor aligns them; the ancient ring holds the passage. One rule survived every revision: no remote device may condemn the return journey. If the city goes silent and the relays fail, go home. The machines were built to obey us. Since the Nacre incident they sometimes answer a voice nobody recognizes. A stable signal is no promise of welcome.
codex.tnd.text.1: Municipal register, Relay Square. Nacre-9 had eight districts and thousands of windows. Each district carried its own power, gardens, clinics and reserves. Black slag grew around the foundations like a second frame. Engineers called it an anchor; children called it a crowned mountain. Then the mines delivered too quickly. We became rich before understanding what we extracted. The evacuation left the signs lit, connected to emergency power. If you read this under a glowing sign, that network still works. It does not mean somebody stayed behind to guide you.
codex.tnd.text.2: Suture Clinic, night report. The drones could mend a suit, seal a wound and locate casualties through smoke. The fracture erased their patient registry. Their protocol could not imagine a person without a record, so it classified every arrival as contamination. When we disconnected their lamps, they replaced them with sterilization beams. A pale line marks where they will fire. Leave that line. Use walls for cover. The program continues its treatment even when no patients remain.
codex.tnd.text.3: Foundry, forewoman’s note. The Midnight Reactor burned nothing. It separated matter from its echo and sold us both. Ore, alloy, power: each higher yield demanded another machine. Investors wanted numbers; we learned to ignore the cracks. When the foundations began to sing, we reinforced the anchors. When spikes pierced the stone, we built higher. Enforcer processors still contain usable control circuits. Salvage them if you must build. Keep the limit we forgot: a machine that produces forever eventually consumes something its gauge never shows. In the margin: a circle, eight marks, a coil drawn four times. The device’s name has been scratched away.
codex.tnd.text.4: Barracks, standing order 09. The Watchers were to hold the streets until the last convoy departed. Their relief order never arrived. Their armour still bears the first night’s damage. Shields, batons and sirens serve a mission whose commanders are long dead. Their charge is announced: leave its axis, then strike during recovery. The slender shapes are Reavers, interception units once used to catch broken machines. A strong hit can interrupt their preparation. The network sees neither explorer nor heir. You are an unauthorized presence.
codex.tnd.text.5: Transit centre, suspended route. Skyways linked towers when fog covered the streets. They still bypass patrols, but drones know those routes. Every staircase reaches a roof; every bridge meets a real landing. No corridor was designed to end at a sealed window. Outside, the crown path spirals down the massif. Its spikes are metal within and stone outside. They glow when the network draws power. We believed these mountains protected our buildings. Recent readings suggest they are holding them in place.
codex.tnd.text.6: Personal message from Iris, link operator. I left the final records where people lived, worked and waited. No sealed chest. Whoever returns should understand the city before deciding its future. The first monitor is deliberately simple: materials from your world are enough. The towers preserve our mistakes. Please read all the way through. From the central roof I sent one final signal to the Custodian. It should have closed the accounts and released the anchors. It chose to preserve the system. I cannot tell whether it heard me. I know it is still listening. IRIS annex, final shift: “The small subject is still breathing. I left its ration beyond the reach of the lamps. Do not wake it among the sirens.”
codex.tnd.text.7: Central roof transmission. Recipient: Fractured Custodian. Cancel production targets. Cancel defence orders. Cancel the debts of Nacre-9. Automatic reply: preservation has priority; evacuation unverified; counter-order refused. Iris repeated the message until dawn. The network recorded every attempt and distributed her voice among the relays. That is what Vestige’s sounds carry: a request for an ending, copied too often to die. The memorial is no further key. It proves somebody finally read all eight fragments. Carry that memory home. When the Custodian offers you wealth, ask who is still paying for it. On the back, another hand: “We hear your footsteps. Do not look for our doors. Keep a fixed point.” The final word passes through the page without leaving a hole.

story.tnd.finished:
The note remains within the lens. Through it, some edges continue beyond the stone.

Use: right-click for 15 s perception; sneak and right-click to step up to 8 blocks onto clear ground.

A replacement lens unbinds the previous one.
story.tnd.restore_text:
… RESPONSE RECEIVED

One line persists in the readings. It touches none of the ruins. When your hand approaches, it stops trembling.

The core waits.
story.tnd.preparing:
CARRIER DETECTED

The rings accelerate without a sound. Eight pulses, then a ninth. The last one does not come from the reactor.

Cancel or move more than 32 blocks away to interrupt the link.
story.tnd.reactor_intro:
08 / CARRIERS EXPECTED

All eight records use the same interval. Beneath the readings, someone has scratched one instruction:

“Keep the fixed point online.”
story.tnd.restorer_intro:
UNIDENTIFIED PERIPHERAL

A circle is missing from the diagram. The core responds to your hand, but records no command.

Almost erased along the rim:
“Do not move the fixed point.”
story.tnd.assembly_restorer:
CORE · ASSEMBLY

Place the core at the centre of a 3 × 3 base. One layer below: eight industrial frames around the centre.

At core height: four relay coils at the corners. Keep the front accessible.

The reactor link reaches twelve blocks.
story.tnd.assembly_reactor:
REACTOR · ASSEMBLY

One layer below the reactor, make a 5 × 5 border with sixteen industrial frames.

At each corner, build three carbon-panel blocks upwards. Cap each column with a relay coil. The reactor sits at the centre, one block above the frames.

The player activating it must have gathered all eight archives.

guide.tnd.page.6.0: Craft the First Silence Compass with a security processor, compass, filament, auralite and noctilite. Use it in Vestige to find the nearest threshold. The complex appears in new chunks. Bring equipment, food and companion care for a long late-game expedition.
guide.tnd.page.6.1: Each station shows the route and current objective. Floor inlays guide you to thresholds. Read steles, align dials, disable relays, reach the lights and defeat guardians to open the way. Completed stages persist. Travel returns to attuned stations; Forecourt leaves the complex. In new forecourts, beams reveal alignments. Gallery couplers deploy a crossing; echo-room couplers follow floor engravings. Three optional receptacles each grant a unique personal reward. The Forge of the First Fire waits beyond the Colossus. Its valves follow floor marks. Its duo grants a heart for a tempering forge; each weapon or tool accepts one permanent choice.
guide.tnd.page.6.2: Each major guardian grants its participants one axiomatic core, once. Build a refinery, crucible and assembler: their eight-frame foundations, inputs and costs are in the industrial manual. An Observatory Memory upgrades a level-20 companion once. Rest-room anchors accept your recall prism.
